prompt:
Hand-painted illustration from a classic children's picture book, painted with opaque gouache on warm off-white watercolour paper. Matte, chalky, fully opaque paint laid down in flat colour shapes with visible brush marks; dry-brush edges where the paper grain shows through; lighter colours painted on top of darker ones; fine flecks of paper texture everywhere. Simple, rounded, friendly shapes for young children: soft round cloud shapes, a plump, slightly leaning lighthouse, a small cottage with soft wobbly walls and a rounded roof, round smooth rocks, naive, slightly flattened perspective. Few large objects and very little small detail: the stones of the quay only hinted with a few loose rounded dabs, no fine rigging, no fine wood grain, no flowers. Warm limited palette of mixed gouache colours: apricot, peach and coral glow along the horizon, warm dusty teal and deep warm blue in the upper sky and the sea, ochre, terracotta, sage green and cream on the buildings; the darkest colour is a warm deep blue-violet, never black. Soft, calm dusk light with gentle contrast. No black outlines. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not smooth digital airbrush, not a detailed postcard, not transparent watercolour, not an oil painting.

Composition for a fixed side-view adventure game screen. The picture will be cropped to a wide 16:9 format: the top 8% and the bottom 8% are cut off, so keep everything important inside the middle band. Horizon at about 46% of the picture height. The stone quay runs as one continuous, level band across the whole width of the picture: its back edge at the water runs straight and level at about 70% of the picture height, and its flat paved top, seen from slightly above, fills the picture from there down to the bottom edge; this broad strip is free and walkable from left to right. On the left (left fifth of the width) the cottage stands on the quay, its chimney top at about 22% of the picture height. On the right the rocky headland with the lighthouse at about 82% of the width, the top of the lighthouse at about 18% of the picture height. The short wooden jetty starts from the back edge of the quay at about 45% of the width and leads out into the water. The two barrels and the coil of rope stand close to the cottage, the stack of crates near the right edge, the lantern post at the back edge of the quay at about 62% of the width; the middle of the quay stays free. The upper middle of the sky, between 25% and 72% of the width and down to about 33% of the picture height, is a calm, almost empty area of flat colour with only a few small stars: the story text of the page will be placed there.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Important for the game version: some things move in the game and are added later as separate animated layers, so paint them exactly as described here, even where the description above says otherwise. Leave out the two fishing boats: they are painted separately and animated as sprites, so the water on both sides of the jetty stays empty. The lighthouse lamp only as a small warm glowing spot without any beam, the lantern only as a small warm spot without a halo, the window warm and lit, no smoke at all above the chimney (smoke and lights are animated separately). No birds.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Both boats seen from the side and a little from above, as boats moored in calm water look from a harbour quay, bow to the right, both at the same scale and side by side with clear empty space between them, each about 40% of the width of the sheet. Boat one (left): a plump, round-bellied wooden fishing boat with a terracotta-red hull, a cream stripe below the gunwale, a tiny cream wheelhouse with one small square window and a short, thick mast. Boat two (right): a slightly smaller open fishing boat with a dusty teal hull, an ochre stripe below the gunwale, a short, thick mast and one furled ochre sail. At most two simple lines of rigging per boat, no fine detail, no nets, no figures, no text or numbers on the hulls. Each hull ends at the bottom in a straight horizontal waterline: only the part above the water is painted, nothing below the waterline, no water, no reflection, no ripples. Each boat isolated on a fully transparent background; no ground, no cast shadow, no frame, nothing cut off at the edge of the sheet.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

prompt:
Sprite sheet for a 2D side-view narrative game: ten figures of the same character, painted by hand in gouache. The first reference image gives the exact layout and the exact poses: ten figures in two rows of five, all at the same scale, the feet of each row on the same baseline. Figures one to eight (in reading order) are a walk cycle to the right in strict side view; figure nine stands still in side view, both feet flat on the ground; figure ten has turned three-quarters towards the viewer. Copy every pose, the positions of both legs and feet, the arms, the parcel and the satchel, and the place and size of each figure exactly from the first reference; only the painting changes. The first reference is a plain 3D render: take only the layout and the poses from it, never its smooth shading or its plastic 3D look. The second reference image only shows the costume, the face and the proportions of the character: do not copy its drawing style, its outlines or its three-view layout. The third reference image shows the gouache technique and the palette of the game: paint the figures with exactly this technique, but do not copy any of its content.

Painting technique: opaque gouache as in a classic hand-painted children's picture book, the same paint, paper grain and warm palette as the background of the game. Every costume part is a flat shape of fully opaque, matte, chalky paint in one clear colour, with only one or two lighter or darker opaque brush strokes to show the form; visible brush marks inside the colour shapes, slightly dry-brushed, soft, slightly wobbly edges. Simple, rounded, friendly shapes for young children: a plump, round body, short round legs, small round paws, a soft rounded head and muzzle. The fur is smooth flat colour with a few brush marks, the scarf a flat red shape with the knitting only hinted by a few strokes. No fur texture, no individual hairs, no felt or plush look, no knitted texture, no soft rounded 3D shading, no airbrush gradients, no glossy highlights, no black outlines. Clear, warm, readable colours: cap and vest a clear dark green, the shirt cream, the scarf red, satchel and parcel warm brown, the fur warm dark grey and creamy white, the broad dark-and-white stripes of the face clearly readable, small dark eyes. Soft, even light from the upper left, mid-light values, no backlight, no rim light, no glow around the figure. It must look like a real gouache painting made by hand: not a 3D render, not a digital painting, not a plush toy, not a cartoon with outlines.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

Each figure isolated on a fully transparent background, with clear empty space between the figures; no ground, no cast shadow, no frame borders, no paper texture around the figures, nothing cut off at the edge of the sheet.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
